# 102. Upgrade nginx to 1.30

**Date:** 2026-10-24

**Optional per env:** _required on all environments_


## CommCare Version Dependency
This change is not known to be dependent on any particular version of CommCare.


## Change Context
nginx is upgraded from 1.28.0 to 1.30.6, the current stable release.

## Details
nginx 1.30 includes several security fixes since 1.28.0. nginx.org
does not publish 1.28 packages for Ubuntu 26.04.

nginx 1.29.7 changed the default for proxied requests to HTTP/1.1 with
keepalive connections to upstream servers. commcare-cloud now sets
`proxy_http_version 1.0` explicitly to keep the previous behaviour.

## Steps to update
To apply, run:

```
commcare-cloud <env> ansible-playbook deploy_proxy.yml
```
